name: cowrie/cowrie
description: Cowrie is a medium to high interaction SSH and Telnet honeypot designed to log brute force attacks and the shell interaction performed by the attacker. It supports emulated shell environments, SSH/Telnet proxying, and experimental LLM-based response generation.
score_rationale: The most widely deployed SSH/Telnet honeypot with 6.2k stars and active development, used in academic and enterprise threat research.
